Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoZanix patient with chest pain followed by loss of consciousness

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 62-year-old female patient with a history of generalized anxiety disorder received their first dose of DemoZanix (dose: 1 tablet twice daily).
Approximately 4 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed chest pain followed by loss of consciousness.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
K. Silva (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter664@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
